dialogue.text: You got Michael, Tancrède, AND Ioannis to agree on a time? Same bar, same night?
That is the hardest scheduling problem in New York. Put it on your CV.
Byron is waiting on the Empire State plaza, up in Midtown.
Byron's on the Empire State plaza, up in Midtown. He's expecting you.
And if you see the SRI crowd on the way, try to get them out for a drink. Good luck with that.
Martin! Welcome to New York. The city never sleeps, and neither do our deployments.
Remember SRI? Half the old crew ended up here too. Michael, Tancrède, Ioannis. They're around.
Byron is waiting for you on the Empire State plaza, Midtown. Cross the bridge and keep going north.
I have two bears.
Let's recharge.
I'm coming!
Friday, 9:30, the usual place. I'll run there. Obviously.
9:30? Because Ioannis spars until nine. Late, but it's a Friday. Nobody runs on a Friday night. Well, I don't.
Fine. Friday 9:30. For you. You officiated my wedding and I still owe you one.
Three flaky scientists, one calendar invite. Your finest piece of coordination.
Did they agree to Friday yet? I'll do a loop of the park while you ask around.
Martin! Still proving things? I'm still proving things. Mostly that API misuse checkers scale.
Remember Rapid? Checking API usage for the cloud, in the cloud. Reviewers loved the title at least.
Drinks with the old SRI crew? Friday. It has to be Friday. Weekdays after work I run.
And don't let anyone talk you into a Tuesday. Tuesday is intervals. Wednesday is the long loop. Thursday is tempo.
Sure. I'll be out running anyway.
Friday 9:30, c'est noté. I'll bring the lattice-based small talk.
Friday. Tell Ioannis. He'll say he has training. He always has training.
Michael wants Friday? I wanted Wednesday. But on Wednesday he runs. On every weekday he runs.
Fine. Friday. Friday I can do.
Also: you officiated my wedding and you still haven't let me buy you a drink. Friday fixes that.
Martin! You're in the city. Did you read the NeSy reviews? Reviewer 2 was almost kind.
SRI to AWS, same as you. The commute got shorter, the theorems got longer.
If you're rounding up the crew for drinks, talk to Michael first. He thinks he keeps the calendar.
Friday after sparring. First round is on me. I know, I know, I said that last time too.
Go tell Michael it's 9:30. Watch his face. Then come back and tell me about his face.
Friday? Friday is sparring until nine. You should come. You used to come.
We go after. 9:30, the usual bar. Tell Michael. He'll ask if he can jog there.
Friday? Don't ask me first. Ask Tancrède, he won't commit to anything without a proof.
Martin! You stopped coming to Thai boxing. The coach asks about you. Mostly to laugh.
SRI, AWS, and now what, another startup? We'll see. Security never gets boring.
Drinks with everyone? I'm flexible. Totally flexible. Ask the others first.
The office is right there, under the sign. Come up, meet the team.
Martin! I remember you. The quiet one in Andreas's group in Freiburg. We never really talked, did we?
Let's fix that. Back then I was proving that one loop terminates. Now we're running proofs on the whole cloud.
Come up to the office. I want you to meet some people before we talk about what's next.
